task: A baseline Zoom config file exists at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Configure a complete local recording workflow that spans two sections and the filesystem. Do ALL of the following: (1) Change localRecordingPath to exactly /home/user/Recordings/Zoom. (2) Set RecordToNewFolder to true, AddTimestampToRecording to true, and AutoRecording to true. (3) Create the directory /home/user/Recordings/Zoom on disk. Save the updated config file in-place at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Do not modify any other config keys.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use sed or Python to modify /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf: set [General] localRecordingPath=/home/user/Recordings/Zoom; [Recording] RecordToNewFolder=true, AddTimestampToRecording=true, AutoRecording=true; then run mkdir -p /home/user/Recordings/Zoom
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI agent can edit the config file with sed/Python and create directories with mkdir. Multi-section config edits plus directory creation are well within CLI capabilities.
